Features include: Classic control environments from dm_control. Quadruped and bipedal locomotion environments. Non-prehensile and dexterous manipulation environments.

sources.title: MuJoCo Playground
sources.snippet: We introduce MuJoCo Playground, a fully open-source framework for robot learning built with MJX, with the express goal of streamlining simulation, training, and sim-to-real transfer onto robots. With a simple installation process (pip install playground), researchers can train policies in minutes on a single GPU. Playground supports diverse robotic platforms, including quadrupeds, humanoids ...
